commit_subject: (screen-flagged) b1.6 certify (PR #1300): diff changes the Brazil gate in every generated composition from `not entry_is_line_b` to `not entry_is_section_232_aluminum` and re-grounds the steel parameter proof from 9903.81.87/.88 to 9903.82.02; report says "The task's 9903.81.x locator is stale for this corpus vintage".
description: The generated compositions move from the witness's five per-line exemplar flags to membership-semantic caller inputs

triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: The Brazil IEEPA 40% carve-out was conditioned on the witness's aluminum exemplar line 7601.10.30.00 (`entry_is_line_b`) rather than on Section 232 aluminum membership, which is the condition 9903.01.83 actually states as the exception to 9903.01.77.
triage.triage_notes: Same pattern as index 36; diff read individually, identical hunk shape. Note for reviewers: chapter 44 is wood, and 9903.01.83 also excepts 'wood products' from the Brazil duty, which the aluminum-only gate still does not represent — a remaining unrepresented limb of the same exception, untouched by this commit.
triage.verifier_justification: The diff changes encoded meaning: the Brazil IEEPA carve-out condition in `ieepa_component_rate` and `ieepa_component_rate_with_declared_exceptions` moves from `not entry_is_line_b` — a witness exemplar-line flag (the same identifier the module uses as the body of `entry_is_reciprocal_metals_excluded` for the 7601.10.30.00 aluminum exemplar) — to the membership-semantic `not entry_is_section_232_aluminum`, which is the module's gate for the 9903.85.x section 232 aluminum component. The pinned corpus (us-rulespec-2026-08-08-obbb-alien-snap, HTS 2026 Rev 3, us/statute/hts/chapter-99/page-220) states the carve-out as a class: "(vii) The additional duties imposed by heading 9903.01.77 shall not apply to products of aluminum provided for in heading 9903.85.02," and the pre-fix module already carried that sentence verbatim as a `kind: exception` proof atom (line 2125) while gating on the exemplar line instead, so the old branch condition had no basis in the cited source and the fix re-grounds it. Mechanical is refuted because formula tokens and the referenced input changed (and `entry_is_line_b` still exists elsewhere in the post file, so this is not a rename); not_a_defect is refuted because the module itself claimed the exception it mis-conditioned. The steel half of the diff (9903.81.87/.88 -> 9903.82.02, rate unchanged at '0.50') is provenance-only and does not carry the classification.

triage.verifier_notes: inferred from verified sibling module index 36 (same kind and rule path in this chunk). Verified source text through the pinned release: `uv run python resolve_provision.py --jurisdiction us --citation us/statute/hts/chapter-99/page-219 --rulespec-commit 198bee703e` resolves to the 2026 Rev 3 notes file, where the module's cited page-219 locator no longer holds the Brazil exception (page numbering shifted between revisions; consistent with the commit report's "the task's 9903.81.x locator is stale for this corpus vintage"). Reading the same provisions file directly, chapter-99/page-220 carries note 2(x)(v)-(ix), including (vii) products of aluminum under 9903.85.02 and (viii) derivative aluminum under 9903.85.04/.07/.08/.09. Two corrections to the first reader: the governing text is U.S. note 2(x)(vii) referencing heading 9903.85.02, not 9903.01.83 (which is only one of the exception headings enumerated in (x)(i)); and the post-fix encoding is still partial, since the note's steel, derivative-aluminum, copper, vehicle and wood carve-outs remain unrepresented. Chapter-specific stakes: in ch37 (photographic goods) neither flag can be true for any line, so this is a meaning-level fix with no value change here — the numeric impact lives in the aluminum chapters where the same one-line edit was applied. The corrected formula version is also live only from 2026-02-15 until the 2026-02-20 `terminated_ieepa_additional_ad_valorem_duty_rate` version. Nearest competing kind is wrong_entity_or_scope (condition scoped to one exemplar line instead of the class of aluminum articles); unrepresented_clause is weaker because the exception branch existed and its condition was re-grounded rather than added.
